description_en: Count the number of security events for a single instance
description_zh: 获取服务器的告警统计信息
name: GetInstanceAlarmStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The data source for statistics on instance alarms, with a default value of aqs:
sas: Situation Awareness data source
aqs: Alarm event data
honeypot: Honeypot
parameters.help_zh:
统计实例告警的数据来源，默认值为aqs：
sas：态势感知数据源
aqs：告警事件数据
honeypot：蜜罐
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server to be queried.
Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) API to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的服务器的UUID。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid
